subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should cron creation automatically persist `delivery.mode="announce"` for `current`, `session:*`, and command jobs, or remain limited to isolated agent-turn jobs?
rationale: The branch changes a user-visible delivery default across persistent-session and command workflows, while merged runtime history and current documentation describe a narrower ownership contract.

options.title: Preserve the current contract
options.body: Limit implicit announce to isolated agent turns, add regressions that persistent targets and commands remain undefined without explicit delivery, and require callers to opt in.

options.title: Approve the expanded default
options.body: Explicitly adopt automatic announce for these additional shapes, align documentation and upgrade expectations, and require real fresh-create and routed-delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Close the proposal
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want a new automatic delivery default beyond the existing isolated-agent-turn behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current contract
recommendation.body: Limit implicit announce to isolated agent turns, add regressions that persistent targets and commands remain undefined without explicit delivery, and require callers to opt in.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried and merged the latest explicit product contract restoring persistent cron session targets.
